sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE (julianday(E.`Examination Date`) - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365 < 18
AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1993-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
  AND L.`T-BIL` BETWEEN 0.3 AND 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    (Nov.T-CHO - Dec.T-CHO) * 100.0 / Nov.T-CHO AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    (SELECT T-CHO 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE strftime('%m', Date) = '11' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981' AND ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')) AS Nov,
    (SELECT T-CHO 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE strftime('%m', Date) = '12' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981' AND ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')) AS Dec;

SELECT P.SEX, AVG(L.`T-BIL`) AS Average_T_BIL
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` NOT BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT T2.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS matches_won
FROM `Match` AS M
INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T2.team_long_name
ORDER BY matches_won DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.birthday) AS Age
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97 AND PA.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT AVG(M.home_team_goal) AS average_home_goals
FROM `Match` M
INNER JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Poland' AND M.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date = '2016-06-23'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT T1.code
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.raceId = 45 AND T2.q3 = '0:01:33';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, SUM(T2.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
GROUP BY T1.driverId
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2009;

SELECT r.name AS race_name, res.points
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.fastestLapSpeed) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2009;

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
  drivers d
  INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  INNER JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
  d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008
),
first_place AS (
  SELECT T1.driverId, T1.time AS first_place_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN race_info AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = 1
),
last_place AS (
  SELECT T1.driverId, T1.time AS last_place_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN race_info AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info))
)
SELECT 
  ((julianday(lp.last_place_time) - julianday(fp.first_place_time)) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) / julianday(lp.last_place_time) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM first_place AS fp, last_place AS lp;

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    drivers d
INNER JOIN 
    lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
INNER JOIN 
    races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    AND lt.lap > 50;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes);

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Blue' AND c2.colour = 'Blonde';

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Copycat';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm = 185 AND race.race = 'Human';

SELECT 
    c_eye.colour AS eye_colour, 
    c_hair.colour AS hair_colour, 
    c_skin.colour AS skin_colour
FROM 
    superhero s
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_hair ON s.hair_colour_id = c_hair.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
INNER JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
INNER JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    g.gender = 'Female' 
    AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_female_marvel
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id;

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025 AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39';

WITH BadgeCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', Date) AS Year,
        COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date)
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2011' THEN BadgeCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2010' THEN BadgeCount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(BadgeCount) AS PercentageDifference
FROM BadgeCounts;

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p 
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mornington') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p 
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Amos') AS ViewCountDifference;

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS Percentage
FROM 
    posts p
INNER JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE 
    p.CreaionDate BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31';

SELECT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.power IS NULL AND l.format = 'Commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS french_percentage
FROM 
    cards c
INNER JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE 
    c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN layout != 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS proportion_non_normal_layout
FROM cards;

SELECT DISTINCT c.types
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE f.language = 'de';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
INNER JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code 
WHERE sets.name = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND cards.artist = 'Adam Rex';

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'Triple' AND m.label LIKE '%carcinogenic%';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Serra Angel') > 
             (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Shrine Keeper') 
        THEN 'Serra Angel'
        ELSE 'Shrine Keeper'
    END AS card_with_higher_converted_mana_cost;

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_percentage
FROM 
  molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
  m.label = 'TR206';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id BETWEEN '21' AND '25';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple-bond' AND a.element IN ('phosphorus', 'bromine');

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.Street 
FROM 
    schools s 
INNER JOIN 
    frpm f 
ON 
    s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode 
WHERE 
    ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule m
JOIN connected c ON m.molecule_id = c.atom_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND c.atom_id = '12';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName1 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName1
        WHEN sc.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName2 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName2
        WHEN sc.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName3 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName3
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools sc
INNER JOIN 
    satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  s.School, 
  AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_Writing_Score
FROM 
  schools s
INNER JOIN 
  satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
  s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY 
  s.School;

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSchools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'N'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY NumberOfSchools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN trans t ON c.district_id = t.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.district_id
    HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 6000 AND AVG(t.amount) < 10000
) AS filtered_districts;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district, 
    d.A3 AS state, 
    ((d.A16 - d.A15) / d.A15) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_change
FROM 
    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
INNER JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.status = 'active' 
    AND l.amount > l.payments;

WITH ClientSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
),
YoungestClients AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(c.birth_date) AS min_birth_date
    FROM 
        client c
)
SELECT 
    a.account_id
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN 
    ClientSalary cs ON c.client_id = cs.client_id
JOIN 
    YoungestClients yc ON c.birth_date = yc.min_birth_date
WHERE 
    cs.avg_salary = (SELECT MAX(avg_salary) FROM ClientSalary)

WITH HighSalaryDistricts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE (A2 + A3 + A4 + A5 + A6 + A7 + A8 + A9 + A10 + A11 + A12 + A13 + A14 + A15 + A16) / 15.0 > 10000
),
FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_count
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM HighSalaryDistricts)
      AND gender = 'W'
),
TotalClients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM HighSalaryDistricts)
)
SELECT (CAST(female_count AS REAL) * 100 / total_count) AS percentage_female
FROM FemaleClients, TotalClients;

SELECT AVG(d.A16) AS average_crimes
FROM district d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE (d.A2 > 4000 OR d.A3 > 4000 OR d.A4 > 4000 OR d.A5 > 4000 OR d.A6 > 4000 OR d.A7 > 4000 OR d.A8 > 4000 OR d.A9 > 4000 OR d.A10 > 4000 OR d.A11 > 4000 OR d.A12 > 4000 OR d.A13 > 4000 OR d.A14 > 4000 OR d.A15 > 4000 OR d.A16 > 4000)
AND a.date >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'running' AND t.date > l.date;

SELECT 
    a.account_id, 
    d.A2 AS district_name, 
    d.A16 AS district_region
FROM 
    account a
INNER JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' 
    AND a.date > t.date;
